fusions.name: Canopy Drop
fusions.desc: Leaps up to 6 tiles to the target and lands on both fists, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Uprooted Branch
fusions.desc: Hurls a torn-off branch for 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles.

fusions.name: Chest-Drum Challenge
fusions.desc: Drums on your chest: up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles turn on you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Picks on the Weak
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.
